result.decision: Put progress, specs and evidence first; keep section links and the spec name pinned while reading.
result.rationale: The user found the full stack of internal records hard to navigate. GPT-5.6 Sol confirmed duplicated evidence and too many destinations in the live website. Engineering details remain available in a separate section without implying a host runner is active.

discovery.observation: Users could not navigate the website easily despite the underlying evidence being available.
discovery.regression: Browser walkthrough and navigation regressions cover deep links, history, mobile drawer dismissal, keyboard selection and visible permission/failure states.
